title: Interior University Society - letterhead template
description: Source-derived stationery template with vertical IUS mark and rose-red top rule. US Letter is a convenient output format, not a verified original paper size. Uncertain original small address block is omitted, leaving an editable blank area. Transparent page background.

title: IUS invitation - 8 June 1988 re-typeset study
description: Re-typeset from the supplied photograph of the invitation dated June 8, 1988. The visible invitation body is reproduced in outlined substitute type. The photographed spelling DAHLLOFF / Dahlloff is retained. The uncertain small header address and handwritten oval around RSVP are omitted. This is a reconstructed study, not an original scan or exact facsimile. Contact details are historical.

title: IUS business fundraising letter - re-typeset study
description: Source-derived re-typesetting of the visible $100 business appeal and address. Font audit v1.1 restores the italic display headlines with Nimbus Roman Bold Italic outlines; questions and body remain upright. Line breaks and exact typeface are reconstructed; obscured salutation and signature are omitted. Historical address and amounts are documentary content, not a current donation request. US Letter canvas is nominal.

title: A university for Prince George - campaign headline
description: Re-typeset campaign wording from the supplied fundraising letter. Font audit v1.1 restores the visibly italic display treatment using outlined Nimbus Roman Bold Italic; original font identity remains unconfirmed. This is a lettering component, not a separate verified historical logo.

title: IUS Support Campaign - reconstructed brochure cover
description: Reconstructed cover layout with source-print logo, support campaign wording and a new manually drawn ten-graduate vector interpretation. The illustration preserves the broad composition, not original facial details or original artist strokes. This is not an exact facsimile. Canvas proportions and paper colour are estimated.

title: IUS supporter petition - reconstructed spread
description: Source-derived re-typesetting of the visible petition panel with the reconstructed supporter form. Body wording is interpreted across the supplied photographs, which contain reflections and partial occlusion; punctuation and line breaks are modern reconstruction choices, not a certified diplomatic transcription. Unreadable fine-print statement on the form is omitted. Historical phone, amount and campaign wording are archival content.
